question: List the name, number, construction date, and type of all buildings, along with the count of addresses associated with each building, the average gross area of the buildings, and the total number of rooms in each building. Sort the results by building name.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE buildings_master AS
SELECT 
  b.building_key AS building_key,
  b.building_number AS building_number,
  b.building_name AS building_name,
  b.building_name AS building_name_long,
  NULL AS building_type,
  b.warehouse_load_date AS warehouse_load_date
FROM beaver.buildings b

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE building_addresses AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    fba.building_key,
    fba.address_purpose,
    fba.city,
    fba.state,
    CAST(fba.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code
  FROM beaver.fac_building_address fba
)
SELECT 
  base.building_key,
  b.building_number,
  base.address_purpose,
  base.city,
  base.state,
  base.postal_code
FROM base
LEFT JOIN beaver.buildings b
  ON b.building_key = base.building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE floors AS
SELECT 
  ff.building_key,
  ff.floor,
  ff.ext_gross_area
FROM beaver.fac_floor ff

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms AS
SELECT 
  fr.building_key,
  fr.room,
  fr.area
FROM beaver.fac_rooms fr

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH b AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(building_name, building_name_long) AS building_name,
    building_number,
    NULL AS construction_date, -- not present in available data
    building_type,
    building_key
  FROM buildings_master
), addr AS (
  SELECT building_key, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM building_addresses
  GROUP BY building_key
), floor_agg AS (
  SELECT building_key,
         AVG(ext_gross_area) AS avg_gross_area
  FROM floors
  GROUP BY building_key
), room_agg AS (
  SELECT building_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms
  FROM rooms
  GROUP BY building_key
)
SELECT 
  b.building_name,
  b.building_number,
  b.construction_date,
  b.building_type,
  COALESCE(addr.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  floor_agg.avg_gross_area,
  COALESCE(room_agg.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM b
LEFT JOIN addr USING (building_key)
LEFT JOIN floor_agg USING (building_key)
LEFT JOIN room_agg USING (building_key)
ORDER BY b.building_name NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(bm.building_name, bm.building_name_long, b.building_name) AS building_name,
    COALESCE(bm.building_number, b.building_number) AS building_number,
    NULL AS construction_date,
    bm.building_type AS building_type,
    COALESCE(bm.building_key, b.building_key) AS building_key,
    b.bldg_gross_square_footage AS bldg_gross_sqft
  FROM buildings_master bm
  FULL OUTER JOIN buildings b
    ON bm.building_number = b.building_number
), addr AS (
  SELECT building_key, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM building_addresses
  GROUP BY building_key
), floor_agg AS (
  SELECT building_key, AVG(ext_gross_area) AS avg_gross_area
  FROM floors
  GROUP BY building_key
), rooms_agg AS (
  SELECT building_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms
  FROM rooms
  GROUP BY building_key
)
SELECT 
  base.building_name,
  base.building_number,
  base.construction_date,
  base.building_type,
  COALESCE(addr.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  COALESCE(base.bldg_gross_sqft, floor_agg.avg_gross_area) AS avg_gross_area,
  COALESCE(rooms_agg.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM base
LEFT JOIN addr USING (building_key)
LEFT JOIN floor_agg USING (building_key)
LEFT JOIN rooms_agg USING (building_key)
ORDER BY base.building_name NULLS LAST;

  COALESCE(addr.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  /* prefer building-level ext_gross_area if available, else floor average */
  COALESCE(b.ext_gross_area_override, floor_agg.avg_gross_area) AS avg_gross_area,
  COALESCE(rooms_agg.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms
